MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 27
   D. 31

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

3. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

5. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 16
   C. 10
   D. 6

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 6
   C. 25
   D. 5

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 11

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 30

17. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

18. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

23. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
